summary.text: Brenna Bird is Iowa's Republican Attorney General, seeking a second term. A former county attorney in Guthrie and Fremont counties and chief of staff to U.S. Rep. Steve King, she was first elected in 2022. Her office has recently sued OpenAI and TP-Link and joined multistate settlements.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Drake University (1997) and a law degree from the University of Chicago (2001).
Served as Guthrie County Attorney and Fremont County Attorney, was an adjunct professor of law at the University of Iowa, and was chief of staff to U.S. Rep. Steve King.

sources.title: Attorney General Brenna Bird Announces Lawsuit against OpenAI for Deceiving Iowa Parents and Iowans about the Safety of ChatGPT
